# Ufriends IT

> Ufriends IT is Nigeria's trusted digital telecommunications, VTU, and government identity services platform. We provide wholesale cheap data, airtime, BVN modification assistance, NIN demographic corrections, instant NIN & BVN slip printing, utility bills, business registrations (CAC), and developer APIs.

## Core Services

- [Cheap Data Plans](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/buy-data-nigeria): Wholesale, highly competitive data bundles for MTN SME/Corporate, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile delivered instantly.
- [BVN Modification Online](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/bvn-modification-nigeria): Lawful assistance with resolving BVN date of birth, name spelling, and phone number mismatches without stressful bank queues.
- [NIN Modification Portal](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/nin-modification-nigeria): Official and lawful NIN demographic detail corrections including name arrangement and date of birth synchronization.
- [Print NIN Slip Online](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/print-nin-slip-nigeria): Instant download and printing of official Regular, Standard, Premium, and VNIN slips.
- [Print BVN Slip Online](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/print-bvn-slip-nigeria): Retrieve and generate verified BVN verification slips with passport photograph and full details.
- [Buy Exam PINs Online](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/buy-exam-pins-nigeria): Instant delivery of WAEC, NECO, and JAMB result checker tokens and scratch card PINs.
- [CAC Business Registration](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/cac-registration-nigeria): Register your enterprise, business name, or company with the Corporate Affairs Commission online.
- [Airtime to Cash](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/convert-airtime-to-cash-nigeria): Convert excess mobile airtime to real cash directly into your Nigerian bank account.
- [Developer API & Reseller](https://www.ufriends.com.ng/reseller): Developer API v1, Sandbox Mode, Node.js and PHP SDKs, and automated webhooks for fintech builders.
